## Setup 

```{r setup, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

dir.create("plots", showWarnings = FALSE)

df <- read_csv("vgsales.csv",
               na = c("", "NA", "N/A"),
               show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Task 1

```{r task1, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
dim(df)
glimpse(df)
colSums(is.na(df))
```

## Task Təmizləmə 

```{r task2, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
rows_raw <- nrow(df)

df <- df %>%
  filter(!is.na(Year)) %>%
  mutate(Year      = as.integer(Year),
         Publisher = replace_na(Publisher, "Unknown"))

cat("Silinən sətir sayı:", rows_raw - nrow(df), "\n")
cat("Qalan sətir sayı:  ", nrow(df), "\n")
colSums(is.na(df))
```

## Task 3

**Genre, Platform və Publisher üzrə qlobal satış (top 10).**
```{r task3, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
top_genre <- df %>%
  group_by(Genre) %>%
  summarise(Global_Sales = sum(Global_Sales), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(Global_Sales)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

top_platform <- df %>%
  group_by(Platform) %>%
  summarise(Global_Sales = sum(Global_Sales), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(Global_Sales)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

top_publisher <- df %>%
  group_by(Publisher) %>%
  summarise(Global_Sales = sum(Global_Sales), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(Global_Sales)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

print(top_genre)
print(top_platform)
print(top_publisher)
```

## Task 4

**Ümumi regional paylar:** 

```{r task4, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
region_total <- df %>%
  summarise(across(c(NA_Sales, EU_Sales, JP_Sales, Other_Sales, Global_Sales), sum))

region_share <- region_total %>%
  mutate(NA_pct    = NA_Sales    / Global_Sales * 100,
         EU_pct    = EU_Sales    / Global_Sales * 100,
         JP_pct    = JP_Sales    / Global_Sales * 100,
         Other_pct = Other_Sales / Global_Sales * 100) %>%
  select(ends_with("_pct")) %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ round(.x, 1)))

print(region_share)
```

## Task 5

**Janr üzrə regional müqayisə:** =

```{r task5, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
genre_region <- df %>%
  group_by(Genre) %>%
  summarise(across(c(NA_Sales, EU_Sales, JP_Sales, Other_Sales, Global_Sales), sum),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(NA_pct = NA_Sales / Global_Sales * 100,
         EU_pct = EU_Sales / Global_Sales * 100,
         JP_pct = JP_Sales / Global_Sales * 100)

genre_region %>%
  select(Genre, NA_pct, EU_pct, JP_pct) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ round(.x, 1))) %>%
  arrange(desc(JP_pct))
```

## Task 6

**Hər regionda ən populyar janr** 

```{r task6, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
genre_region %>%
  summarise(NA_top = Genre[which.max(NA_Sales)],
            EU_top = Genre[which.max(EU_Sales)],
            JP_top = Genre[which.max(JP_Sales)])

genre_region %>%
  pivot_longer(c(NA_Sales, EU_Sales, JP_Sales), names_to = "Region", values_to = "Sales") %>%
  group_by(Region) %>%
  mutate(Share_in_region = round(Sales / sum(Sales) * 100, 1)) %>%
  slice_max(Sales, n = 3) %>%
  select(Region, Genre, Sales, Share_in_region)
```

## Task 7

**İllik trend (1980–2016).** 

```{r task7, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
yearly <- df %>%
  filter(Year >= 1980, Year <= 2016) %>%
  group_by(Year) %>%
  summarise(Global_Sales = sum(Global_Sales), .groups = "drop")

peak <- yearly %>% slice_max(Global_Sales, n = 1)

print(yearly, n = 40)
print(peak)
```

## Task 8

**Ən çox satan 10 oyun**

```{r task8, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
top_games <- df %>%
  arrange(desc(Global_Sales)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  select(Name, Platform, Genre, Year, Global_Sales)

print(top_games)
```

## Task 9

**Vizuallaşdırma 1: stacked bar chart.** Janr üzrə regional satış (NA, EU, JP, Other).

```{r task9, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
genre_long <- genre_region %>%
  select(Genre, NA_Sales, EU_Sales, JP_Sales, Other_Sales) %>%
  pivot_longer(-Genre, names_to = "Region", values_to = "Sales") %>%
  mutate(Region = str_remove(Region, "_Sales"),
         Region = factor(Region, levels = c("NA", "EU", "JP", "Other")))

p1 <- ggplot(genre_long,
             aes(x = reorder(Genre, Sales, FUN = sum), y = Sales, fill = Region)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Regional Sales by Genre (stacked)",
       x = "Genre", y = "Sales (million units)", fill = "Region") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

print(p1)
ggsave("plots/01_stacked_genre_region.png", p1, width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 150)
```

## Task 10

**Vizuallaşdırma 2: illik trend xətti.** Qlobal satışın 1980–2016 dövründəki dəyişməsi, pik il qırmızı ilə işarələnib.

```{r task10, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
p2 <- ggplot(yearly, aes(x = Year, y = Global_Sales)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(color = "steelblue") +
  geom_point(data = peak, color = "red", size = 3) +
  geom_text(data = peak,
            aes(label = paste0(Year, ": ", round(Global_Sales, 1), "M")),
            vjust = -1, color = "red") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1980, 2015, 5)) +
  labs(title = "Global Video Game Sales per Year (1980-2016)",
       x = "Year", y = "Global sales (million units)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

print(p2)
ggsave("plots/02_yearly_trend.png", p2, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 150)
```

## Task 11

**Vizuallaşdırma 3: top 10 publisher bar chart.**

```{r task11, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
p3 <- ggplot(top_publisher,
             aes(x = reorder(Publisher, Global_Sales), y = Global_Sales)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkorange") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Global_Sales)), hjust = -0.1, size = 3.5) +
  coord_flip() +
  expand_limits(y = max(top_publisher$Global_Sales) * 1.1) +
  labs(title = "Top 10 Publishers by Global Sales",
       x = "Publisher", y = "Global sales (million units)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

print(p3)
ggsave("plots/03_top10_publishers.png", p3, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 150)
```

## Task 12

**Bonus 1: hansı onillikdə oyun başına orta satış ən yüksəkdir?**

```{r task12, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
decade_avg <- df %>%
  filter(Year >= 1980, Year <= 2016) %>%
  mutate(Decade = paste0(Year %/% 10 * 10, "s")) %>%
  group_by(Decade) %>%
  summarise(Avg_Sales_per_Game = mean(Global_Sales),
            Games = n(),
            .groups = "drop")

print(decade_avg)
```

## Task 13

**Bonus 1 qrafiki:** onilliklər üzrə oyun başına orta satış.

```{r task13, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
p4 <- ggplot(decade_avg, aes(x = Decade, y = Avg_Sales_per_Game)) +
  geom_col(fill = "seagreen") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Avg_Sales_per_Game, 2)), vjust = -0.5) +
  labs(title = "Average Global Sales per Game by Decade",
       x = "Decade", y = "Avg sales per game (million units)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

print(p4)
ggsave("plots/04_decade_avg.png", p4, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 150)
```

## Task 14

**Bonus 2: grouped bar chart.** Qlobal satışa görə top 5 janr NA, EU və JP üzrə yan-yana.

```{r task14, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
top5_genres <- genre_region %>%
  slice_max(Global_Sales, n = 5) %>%
  pull(Genre)

grouped_data <- genre_long %>%
  filter(Genre %in% top5_genres, Region %in% c("NA", "EU", "JP")) %>%
  mutate(Genre = factor(Genre, levels = top5_genres))

p5 <- ggplot(grouped_data, aes(x = Genre, y = Sales, fill = Region)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Top 5 Genres: NA vs EU vs JP",
       x = "Genre", y = "Sales (million units)", fill = "Region") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)

print(p5)
ggsave("plots/05_grouped_top5_genres.png", p5, width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 150)
```

## Task 15

**İnsight-lar üçün əlavə analiz:** 

```{r task15, error=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=TRUE, include=TRUE}
top_pub_region <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(c(NA_Sales, EU_Sales, JP_Sales), names_to = "Region", values_to = "Sales") %>%
  group_by(Region, Publisher) %>%
  summarise(Sales = sum(Sales), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  slice_max(Sales, n = 3)

top_plat_region <- df %>%
  pivot_longer(c(NA_Sales, EU_Sales, JP_Sales), names_to = "Region", values_to = "Sales") %>%
  group_by(Region, Platform) %>%
  summarise(Sales = sum(Sales), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  slice_max(Sales, n = 3)

print(top_pub_region)
print(top_plat_region)
```
